Scientists Warn Climate Change Accelerating Beyond Response Capacity

Scientists are warning that climate change is accelerating at a pace faster than humanity can respond to, according to reports. A book argues that accelerating climate change is the most serious threat facing the world today. Additionally, an individual working for a major insurer stated that much of their industry is misrepresenting numbers in the face of the climate crisis, potentially taking on more risk than they should and risking far-reaching consequences if a major disaster occurs.
